page.content:
Gnome cleric of Sarenrae and the party's conscience.

How Pike Trickfoot connects

  • Faction: Vox Machina — Pike Trickfoot is the cleric of Vox Machina.
  • Character: Ashley Johnson — Ashley Johnson plays Pike Trickfoot.

What is Pike Trickfoot?

Pike Trickfoot is Ashley Johnson's holy gnome, the Sarenrae cleric who pulls Vox Machina back from the dead and from Grog's worst ideas.

Key threads lead to Vox Machina and Ashley Johnson.
